points.text: Very little numerical evidence presented.
Baselines limited; add random-Fourier-feature MLP and similar.
Experimental settings simple; add 3D regression or higher-order PDEs.
No empirical validation of Gaussian splatting / novel view synthesis setting.
Inner matrix transformation T may need a different form to be PD for cited results.
Bound on number of splats k is likely loose.
More ablations needed for low-dimensional tasks.
Overfitting acknowledged but no principled regularizer or experiments.
Baselines could include tuned classical kernels and more PDE regimes.
No high-dimensional experiments; deep splat networks untested.
All experiments 1D/2D; bound implies curse of dimensionality limiting applicability.
No memory or runtime comparison with MLP/KAN baselines.
Definition of 'low dimensionality' not clarified.
Only synthetic/toy PDEs; no real-world data validation.
Not contrasted with adaptive RBF networks, mixture density networks, mesh-free methods.
No concrete regularization strategy against overfitting in experiments.
Abstract claims estimation and inverse problems but none are tested.
'High interpretability' never evaluated.
Experimental details undefined: validation set, noise, ground truth, operator, metric.
No results table with mean and std over seeds.
Presentation order: notation introduced late, no overview figure.
Typos, duplicated references, 'right to left' remark.
Baselines untuned and unusual; no Fourier, RBF or SIREN baselines.
Single runs only.
'Order of magnitude' claim only readable from figures.
Benefit of anisotropic heterogeneous splats untested; no isotropic ablation.
Interpretability never evaluated.
Unified framework, 3DGS recovery and inverse-problem claims overstated; no experiments.
Proof gaps in Prop. 3 and Thm. 3; main-text statement drops factor.
Thm. 3 rate worse than uniform grid; says nothing about anisotropy.
Chebyshev comparison inflates its parameter budget; unequal data and cost.
Fisher-Rao component of Thm. 1 unused in experiments.
Thm. 1 A-gradient sign inconsistent between statement and derivation.
Haar exact-fit claim for sawtooth incorrect.
Notation errors: duplicate determinant factor, constant, isotropic vs identity covariance.
Iteration axis units inconsistent across figure panels.
Splat model not differentiated from RBF networks and PIRBN.
Prior WFR descent on Gaussian mixtures uncited.
Wasserstein gradient for finite splats is ordinary parameter gradient; mostly reinterpretation.
Recovering 3DGS is a formulation, not derivation; claim overstated.
Related work thin on Gaussian-primitive fields, free-knot approximation, close prior work.
Prop. 3 universality follows from classical RBF results.
Thm. 3 rate worse than grid and shows no benefit of anisotropy.
Prop. 1 isotropic assumption mismatches Def. 1; duplicate bibliography.
NVS case never run; 3DGS pipeline elements absent.
Only d at most 2 tested; behaviour in 3-5 dimensions unknown.
Sharp features untested; no epsilon sweep for Allen-Cahn.
Adaptive RBF, meshless collocation and PIRBN literature uncited.
Fourier-feature, hash-grid and SIREN baselines missing.
Evaluation cost, memory and training time not reported.
Conditioning of gradient flow with ill-conditioned A not discussed.
No ethics/societal impact statement.
Baselines untuned and unusually configured; RBF, Fourier, SIREN missing.
Chebyshev/Haar comparison not like-for-like; parameter accounting inflated.
Training cost not compared against Chebyshev/Haar.
Only one target function; robustness claim anecdotal.
No variance or repeat runs anywhere.
Theory-experiment disconnect: Fisher-Rao part unused, Allen-Cahn not covered.
Proof gaps: rank-one A, non-negative measure, Chebyshev inequality, gradient sign.
No code, hardware or wall-clock reported.
Allen-Cahn ground truth and Section 4.3 quantities undefined.
Typos, wrong figure and citation references, duplicate bibliography entries.

P.summary: Only simple low-dimensional settings; no higher-dimensional experiments.
Insufficient contrast with RBF, mixture and mesh-free methods.

Q.summary: Unified framework and 3DGS recovery claims overstated.
Experimental details and ground truth undefined.
No result tables, variance or repeat runs.
Baselines untuned; RBF, Fourier-feature, SIREN missing.
No isotropic ablation for anisotropy benefit.
Approximation rate weak and ignores anisotropy.
Not differentiated from RBF networks/PIRBN and meshless methods.
WFR flow contribution has uncited prior work; mostly reinterpretation.
Sharp features and epsilon sweep untested.
Training time and cost not reported.
Conditioning of gradient flow not discussed.
